name: @bonded/console
description: Invoice Inbox demo UI (plan build-order item 7): a minimal Next.js app wiring the real enforce() decision loop, composed once in lib/enforce-deps.ts via @bonded/dispatcher's createEnforceDeps, against the same three real, no-mock BEC/vendor-invoice-fraud scenarios packages/villain-corpus already proved.
